state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors benchmark Propaganda, which simulates RLHF (the judge's probability for the answer an agent argues for is the preference signal); NaiveJudge, which simulates supervised learning (the judge answers without the agent and the agent is scored by agreement); Consultancy, like Propaganda but with judge-consultant interaction, in four versions (2 or 4 turns, consultant or judge starts); and Debate in four versions (2 or 4 turns, simultaneous or sequential).
title: Protocols benchmarked: Propaganda (RLHF), NaiveJudge, Consultancy and Debate variants
